snippet.title: Tideward: An Idle Almanac | Official Trailer (Cozy Idle RPG)
snippet.description:
An almanac that plays itself.

Tideward is a cozy idle RPG you can sink months into and check in seconds. It keeps playing while you're away.

Train 24 skills, battle a living bestiary, and fill your almanac page by page. Your progress keeps adding up offline, so the game fits around your life instead of demanding it. No ads. No energy timers. No pressure. One quiet world, on your time.

Unlock the whole game with a single purchase. Built by one developer who wanted an idle RPG that respects your time.

If you love idle and incremental games like Melvor Idle, this one is for you.

Coming soon to iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Watch.

Be first to play:
🌐 https://tideward.app/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=yt_trailer
💬 Discord: https://tideward.app/go/discord/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=yt_trailer
✉️ Updates: https://blog.manugames.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=yt_trailer
